reason: Verified that the SuperAgent application can receive a message, send it to an agent, and receive a correct response within the expected timeframe.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Application loaded successfully with sidebar showing agents
Clicked on "QA-20260909-202624-hq3q" agent in sidebar — Agent detail page opened showing agent name and idle status
Verified agent status is "idle" — Confirmed status indicator displayed "idle" in the UI header
Clicked message input field and typed "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message text entered successfully in the input field
Clicked Send message button — Message was submitted, URL changed to session view, agent status changed to "working"
Waited for response — Agent responded within seconds with the message "4" displayed in the chat log
Verified response contains "4" — Response clearly visible in chat area as the correct answer to the math question
Took final screenshot — Captured the complete conversation showing user message and agent response with "4"
